summary: Liston Newton Advisory is a roughly 50-year-old Victorian accounting and advisory firm with offices in South Melbourne, Melbourne, Malvern and elsewhere. Group CEO Peter Antonius is leading a growth and technology transformation, including a Philippines-based support team and a newly hired AI engineer, after a management buyout in 2025.

sources.title: How this accounting firm plans to grow revenue by 70%
Leading Through Growth: Building the Firm of the Future

claims.text: Liston Newton Advisory is an accounting and business advisory firm with offices across NSW, VIC and QLD, including South Melbourne at Level 3/67 Palmerston Crescent.
claims.quote: With several offices dotted across Australia, we’ll happily welcome you in for a coffee and a face-to-face meeting.

claims.text: Peter Antonius is Group CEO of Liston Newton Advisory (current), in the role since May 2022.
claims.quote: Group CEO - Liston Newton Advisory (Current) May 2022 - Present

claims.text: Peter is a qualified accountant (CPA, CA ANZ) whose role focuses on strategy with the Board and Executive; he says technology is key to high performance teams.
claims.quote: the experiences of which have highlighted the importance of technology in building high performance teams and organisations

claims.text: In a NAB interview (Oct 2026) Peter said the firm recently hired a full-time AI engineer and plans to recruit a second.
claims.quote: It recently hired a full-time AI engineer and plans to recruit a second.

claims.text: Peter expects AI and automation to be embedded throughout the firm's business systems within the next few years.
claims.quote: Within the next few years, Peter expects AI and automation to be embedded throughout its business systems.

claims.text: Liston Newton established a Philippines-based team of about 20 to support local staff with accounting administration.
claims.quote: It established a Philippines-based team of about 20 to support local staff with accounting administration.

claims.text: The firm is on track for $9.3 million revenue this year, targeting $16 million by end of 2030, and completed a management buyout in June 2025.
claims.quote: The firm's growth ambitions were put to the test in June 2025 when the business completed a management buyout

claims.text: Peter said the firm needs to bulk up, investing in systems, people and technology, because scale will matter.
claims.quote: We absolutely need to bulk up to thrive, to remain relevant to our clients and invest in systems, people and technology

claims.text: Peter appeared on the Lead to Grow podcast in June 2026 about building the firm of the future; the episode describes a top 100 firm, boutique on its way to mid-tier.
claims.quote: boutique on its way to mid-tier

claims.text: Liston Newton's South Melbourne page lists Xero bookkeeping and recordkeeping among its services.
claims.quote: Business Accountants Xero Bookkeeping Taxation Accountancy Tax Compliance

claims.text: The firm targets small to medium businesses turning over between $1 million and $50 million, with divisions in business advisory, bookkeeping, wealth and lending.
claims.quote: we’ve expanded to better support our target market – small to medium businesses that turn over between $1 to $50 million

hooks.text: Peter publicly said AI and automation will be embedded across the firm's systems and an AI engineer has been hired, so he is receptive to AI tooling for bookkeeping reconciling.
Scaling to mid-tier with a Philippines accounting-admin team means reconciling volume is high and needs traceable controls.
Xero bookkeeping is a core division across several offices.

risks.text: A full-time AI engineer (and a second planned) means Liston Newton may build its own automation instead of buying.
Management buyout in June 2025 and ongoing restructuring may change decision makers.

gaps: Platinum Xero Partner status from CRM not confirmed on a fetched page.
No recent LinkedIn posts by Peter found beyond profile.
No job ads checked for bookkeeping roles.

fetch listonnewton.com.au home and South Melbourne page
